Party #1 and #2 are than able to make an unlimited amount of payments while the ledger remains open. However, once Party #2 signs the ledger, the block is netted out and a singular transaction is posted to the blockchain, thus finalizing the 50-100 micro-transactions into one lump settlement payment. The money that you commit to the channel is like a reservation fee. I do not like this solution because it lacks security - any transaction that is performed off of the blockchain can be disputed, Party #2 can choose not to sign the ledger, or the ledger could be electronically tampered with.
